name: Kinross Gold Corporation
research_rationale: Refreshed Yahoo data support strong FCF and deleveraging, matching the screen, but missing Kinross filings and November litigation over production guidance leave the strong-buy thesis only partly corroborated.

weekly_updates.summary:
News since September flags Q3 cash-flow results, a 50% FCF capital-return target, and a US class action over production outlook and Round Mountain Phase S.  
Refreshed Yahoo financials still imply ~$2.6bn annual FCF and lower leverage; Kinross issuer filings in the pack remain unverified.  
Screen conviction stays strong_buy (~0.83); filing and litigation gaps limit how far research can endorse the signal.
